<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">American Medical Alert Corp. is committed to providing call center centric solutions that improve healthcare delivery through (a) an expansive portfolio of home-based Remote Patient Monitoring (&#8220;RPM&#8221;) technologies and (b) best in class monitoring and contact center services for healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s business strategy leverages its ability to design, develop and integrate health and safety monitoring technologies with its multi-site, U.S. based healthcare communication services infrastructure to&#160;&#160;provide its customers with lower cost, high touch solutions that sustain independent living, encourage better self care activities and improve communications of critical health information.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160;</font><br>
&#160;</div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">3</font></div>

<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">AMAC&#8217;s evolution is based on a disciplined approach to defining new call center service categories, developing and distributing innovative health monitoring technologies and extending the value we create to our customers.&#160;&#160;Today, AMAC is the voice of help for well known brands providing personal emergency response; the reminder when someone forgets to take medications; the front office support for physicians and clinics around the country; the compassionate support to answer a question about a drug regimen or therapy option; the report of an adverse drug event; and the clinician providing oversight of daily vital sign capture in health management programs.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">As the continued trend towards effective and precise end to end communication expands into new areas of health and wellness, AMAC believes that it can further its growth objectives more readily by combining its divisions and their respective management teams in a way that will increase the number and size of our opportunities.&#160;&#160;Management believes that realigning its divisions into a more homogeneous device, technology, and services company will poise the organization for greater cross offering opportunities.<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 12pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160;</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>As such, in conjunction with realigning its internal resources, management is discussing the possibility of a name change with the Board of Directors to properly reflect the nature of American Medical Alert Corp.&#8217;s evolution in healthcare communications.&#160;&#160;After appropriate consideration and analysis, if approved by our Board of Directors, this item would be proposed at the next annual meeting of shareholders for approval.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Operating Segments:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s activities are reported through two operating segments. The first segment, Health Safety and Monitoring Services (&#8220;HSMS&#8221;), is comprised of the development and marketing of Remote Patient Monitoring (&#8220;RPM&#8221;) technologies that include personal emergency response systems (&#8220;PERS&#8221;), medication reminder and dispensing systems, telehealth/disease management technologies and safety monitoring systems to pharmacies.&#160;&#160;The second segment, Telephony Based Communication Services (&#8220;TBCS&#8221;),&#160;provides of centralized call center solutions primarily to the healthcare community, including traditional after hours services, daytime services applications, and <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">pharmaceutical support and</font>&#160;clinical trial recruitment call center services.&#160;&#160;For the year ended December 31, 2010, the HSMS segment and the TBCS segment accounted for 51% and 49%, respectively, of the Company&#8217;s gross revenues<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company markets its offerings directly to healthcare providers, pharmaceutical companies, managed care organizations and through a network of distributors. The Company also offers certain products and services directly to consumers.&#160;&#160;During 2011, the Company plans to continue with its internally driven sales and marketing efforts with its currently planned organic growth strategies and also intends to expand its acquisition program activities.&#160;&#160;See Part II, Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company was formed in 1981 as a New York corporation.&#160;&#160;Since then, the Company has completed eleven call center acquisitions.<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>The Company&#8217;s financial model is primarily the generation of monthly recurring revenues (&#8220;MRR&#8221;).&#160;&#160;Under this model, each operating segment generates prescribed monthly fees for services and equipment rendered throughout the duration of a service agreement.&#160;&#160;For the year ended December 31, 2010, approximately 93% of the Company&#8217;s revenue was generated from MRR.&#160;&#160;The remaining 7% of revenue was derived from its pharmaceutical and clinical trial projects, installation charges and product sales<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">B.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Products and Services</font></div>

<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Health and Safety Monitoring Systems (HSMS)</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The ongoing objective of the HSMS segment is to create a compelling value proposition by addressing the fundamental need to allow individuals to age in place with home based health monitoring technologies through a single monitoring platform. The HSMS RPM platform provides a single source for AMAC&#8217;s customers to access a broad spectrum of technologies, from rudimentary to sophisticated, to deliver individualized, cost effective monitoring as a patient&#8217;s needs evolve.</font></div>

<div>
<table align="center" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">
<div style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">a.</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS)</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">PERS is the Company&#8217;s core product and service offering.&#160;&#160;The system consists of a console unit and a wireless transmitter generally worn as a pendant or on the wrist by the client.&#160;&#160;In the event of an emergency, the client is able to summon immediate assistance via a two-way voice system that connects the client&#8217;s home telephone with the Company&#8217;s emergency response center.&#160;&#160;The ability to access and obtain assistance, particularly after a fall or during a medical emergency, has been proven to reduce overall healthcare costs and increase the ability of an individual to remain independent at home.&#160;&#160;In 2000, total direct costs related to fall injuries exceeded $19 billion in adults aged 65 and older. By 2020, the annual direct and indirect cost of fall injuries is expected to reach $54.9 billion.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">In May 2010, AMAC announced the formation of, and its investment in, Lifecomm, LLC, a joint venture with Hughes Telematics Inc. and Qualcomm Inc., and its plans to launch a mobile Personal Emergency Response Service as part of its expanding product portfolio.&#160;&#160;The introduction of a state-of-the-art mobile PERS solution, designed to extend affordable and potentially lifesaving emergency assistance to its users, is expected to be a major advancement in providing connected location-based services.&#160;&#160;The mobile PERS solution will consist of a wearable lightweight device with one-touch access to an emergency assistance call center.&#160;&#160;Inside the device, a cellular modem will enable wireless voice and data communications, and an embedded GPS combined with other sensors will enable location-based tracking and monitoring of the person wearing the device.&#160;&#160;A personalized web portal for the user and/or caregiver will provide access to information about user activity and location</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In November 2009, Apria Healthcare announced an exclusive strategic alliance with AMAC to provide PERS under an Apria branded service.&#160;&#160;During the first half of 2010, ApriaAlert was introduced to selected geographic markets within Apria&#8217;s national footprint.&#160;&#160;As a result of positive experiences with AMAC, Apria expanded its PERS product offering throughout its nationwide branch network, which annually serves over two million patients.&#160;&#160;Continued expansion into other Apria relationships is planned for 2011<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">During the second quarter of 2010, AMAC secured a new relationship with one of the nation&#8217;s largest homecare companies.&#160;&#160;Based on the success experienced in the first set of pilot implementations, national rollout is planned to continue throughout 2011.&#160;&#160;Under the terms of this unique service model, AMAC has the potential to grow and retain its subscriber base at a much greater rate than in other distribution models</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In 2010, the Company executed several private label service agreements, including one with a multi-facility hospital system, under which the first group of subscribers commenced PERS service during the fourth quarter.&#160;&#160;The multi-facility hospital system agreement has the potential to generate even greater revenue if, as contemplated by the hospital system, other hospitals in that system join the program after initial rollout at one hospital.&#160;&#160;Most recently, AMAC was selected as the provider for the Visiting Nurse Services of New York&#8217;s private pay PERS offering.&#160;&#160;Launched in January 2011, VNSNYAssist&#8482; is marketed to caregivers seeking alternatives to enhance aging in place capabilities.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">AMAC&#8217;s PERS is marketed directly to consumers, providers and by third party resellers under multiple brands, including VoiceCare&#174;, Walgreens Ready Response&#8482;, Response Call&#174;, ApriaAlert&#8482; and most recently VNSNYAssist&#8482; .</font></div>

<td style="WIDTH: 36pt">
<div style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">b.</font></div>
</td>
<td>
<div align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Medication Adherence Appliances</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The second component of AMAC&#8217;s RPM platform addresses medication adherence, which has been defined as a critical component of patient self management.&#160;&#160;One in two patients does not take his or her medications as prescribed, costing the United States an estimated $300 billion per year in unnecessary healthcare costs.&#160;&#160;In a medication adherence study, of adults 65+ who reported to be noncompliant, 84% cited simple forgetfulness as the reason.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedSmart&#174;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedSmart is a powerful solution that organizes, reminds and dispenses pills in accordance with prescribed treatment regimens. Easy to set up and use, MedSmart improves adherence to medication regimens and reduces the risk of missed doses and overdosing errors to improve clinical outcomes and quality of life.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">6</font></div>

<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">With MedSmart&#8217;s innovative event reporting and notification capability, family caregivers and healthcare professionals can proactively support independent living. MedSmart&#8217;s docking base serves as the gateway for remote programming and event reporting. When connected to a household phone, MedSmart transmits device and dispensing history to a secure server supported with a web application for review by authorized individuals, such as relatives or medical professionals. Through AMAC&#8217;s personalized notification system, alerts can be sent to track adherence, address dosing errors and predict refill requirements.&#160;&#160;The ability to communicate these events creates a new capability to easily track adherence, proactively modify behavior and improve compliance.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Throughout 2010, the Company secured pilot program related contracts with several healthcare entities with the goal of demonstrating MedSmart&#8217;s value proposition, such as reducing costs associated with non-adherence related hospitalizations, improving disease management outcomes and increasing pharmacy script yield through ongoing monitoring of chronic medication utilization<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-STYLE: italic">.</font> Encouraging results have led to execution of commercial contracts with various healthcare providers and distributors.&#160;&#160;In addition to these efforts, in October 2010, the Company launched its first MedSmart direct to consumer pilot program.&#160;&#160;The results of this pilot program provided valuable market intelligence that will allow the Company to more effectively position MedSmart in the market.&#160;&#160;At this time, management is reevaluating more cost effective, direct to consumer deployment methods.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedTime<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 70%; VERTICAL-ALIGN: text-top">&#174;</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedTime is an electronic medication reminder and dispensing unit marketed under an exclusive<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>licensing, manufacturing and distribution agreement which began in 1999.&#160;&#160;This agreement originates from PharmaCell AB, a Swedish company, with licensing rights extending throughout the United States, Canada and Mexico. The initial term of the agreement was five years requiring the Company to achieve certain purchase minimums in order to maintain exclusivity.&#160;&#160;Thereafter, the agreement converted to an evergreen with annual purchase minimums of 1,500 units. The Company has met all minimums with PharmaCell to date and continues to maintain exclusivity.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">
<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" id="hangingindent" width="100%" style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman">
<tr valign="top">
<td align="right" style="WIDTH: 36pt">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">c.&#160;</font></div>
</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Telehealth systems</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Rounding out AMAC&#8217;s RPM portfolio is AMAC&#8217;s telehealth delivery capability. As a distributor of the Health Buddy&#174; System, many of the Company&#8217;s customers have successfully demonstrated the value proposition of incorporating disease management technologies into a patient&#8217;s plan of care.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">We intend to continue to broaden our RPM portfolio with lower cost, high touch telehealth solutions.&#160;&#160;In 2010 AMAC launched an Independent Review Board study of its&#160;&#160;new low-cost telehealth solution, Telesmart&#8482;.&#160;&#160;A commercial launch of the Telesmart&#8482; solution is planned for 2011.&#160;&#160;This AMAC operated telehealth platform is directed toward providers who require a low-cost solution, easy installation, reliable transmission of vital sign data in real-time and ease of use on the patient side.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">HSMS Marketing Channels</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The HSMS product line is distributed to the subscriber base through five primary marketing channels: AMAC&#8217;s Direct to Consumer/Private Label Program; Third Party Reimbursed Programs with government customers; the Distributor Network, made up of Direct Service Providers; the Purchase and Monitoring Program; and Safecom, Pharmacy Security Systems.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Direct to Consumer/Private Label Program:</font>&#160;&#160;The Company has embarked upon a mission to increase consumer utilization of PERS through multiple direct to consumer healthcare related touch points.&#160;&#160;Individuals can access the PERS through AMAC&#8217;s corporate sales office, via any regional office or by mail order. AMAC has referral arrangements with home care agencies and case managers throughout the United States who introduce and recommend PERS to clients and generate an ongoing source of new consumer interest.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In February 2007, the Company announced it had entered into a relationship with Walgreen Co. (&#8220;Walgreen&#8221;) to provide the Company&#8217;s flagship PERS under the Walgreen brand. Walgreens Ready Response&#8482; Medical Alert system is offered though e-commerce efforts and direct response mechanisms throughout the United States and Puerto Rico.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In November 2009, Apria Healthcare announced an exclusive strategic alliance with AMAC to provide PERS under an Apria branded service.&#160;&#160;During the first quarter of 2010, ApriaAlert was introduced to selected geographic markets within Apria&#8217;s national footprint.&#160;&#160;As a result of positive experiences in the limited introduction phase, Apria expanded its PERS product offering throughout its nationwide branch network which annually serves over two million patients.&#160;&#160;Continued expansion into other Apria-operated relationships is planned for 2011.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">Third Party Reimbursed Programs (Government Customers):&#160;&#160;</font>The Company&#8217;s PERS are on the Centers for Medicare &amp; Medicaid Services list of approved monitoring devices for Medicaid.&#160;&#160;Payment for PERS equipment and monitoring services is available through various state Medicaid Home and Community Based Services waivers programs and other Medicaid funded homecare services programs.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Overall<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">, </font>during 2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">,</font> 11% of AMAC&#8217;s revenue was derived from PERS services contracts with government customers<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160;</font>for Medicaid reimbursed programs.&#160;&#160;AMAC believes that the use of homecare will continue to increase, representing an ongoing opportunity for broader use of the Company&#8217;s current and future products.</font></div>

The facilities provide primary monitoring for their residents and some employ AMAC&#8217;s ERC to serve as their back-up center. AMAC&#8217;s PMP offerings include its console unit, the Model 1100 residential system and ResiLink, an enhanced software package for its facility monitoring platform.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s primary communications center is located at 36-36 33<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 70%; VERTICAL-ALIGN: text-top">rd</font> Street, Long Island City, New York.&#160;&#160;In April 2003, the Company opened a one-hundred seat state-of-the-art call center to centralize the full scope of communication services offered by AMAC.&#160;&#160;The call center was built with system-wide redundancy and can accommodate growth up to three (3) times its current volume. Phone service to the call center is provided by three separate carriers and is configured to provide continuous service in the event of disruption.&#160;&#160;Phone circuit entry to the building is provided through a reinforced steel conduit built to UL Central Station Standards. The call center&#8217;s electricity supply is maintained by a comprehensive, three tiered back-up system. The system consists of dual power supplies at the telephone switch, an uninterruptible power supply and a diesel generator.</font></div>

Critical systems are equipped with secure remote access and diagnostic abilities, enabling offsite as well as on-site access to IS system support 24/7.</font></div>

</td>
<td align="left">
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Impact of Government Regulations</font></div>
</td>
</tr></table>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">As mentioned above, during 2010<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">,</font> 11% of AMAC&#8217;s revenue was derived from PERS services contracts with government customers for Medicaid reimbursed programs.&#160;&#160;Government legislative initiatives, if enacted, could impose pressures on the pricing structures applicable to the Company&#8217;s PERS services.&#160;&#160;On the other hand, new reimbursement programs such as those relating to our Telehealth/Disease Monitoring and Management (&#8220;TH/DMM&#8221;) products and services&#160;could provide significant additional sources of reimbursement from government entitlements.&#160;&#160;Depending on the nature and extent of any new laws and/or regulations, or possible changes in the interpretation of existing laws and/or regulations, any such changes could affect revenue, operating margins, and profitability.&#160;&#160;See the risk factors below in Item 1A entitled &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-STYLE: italic">Our business may be adversely impacted by new government regulations or changes to current government regulations</font>&#8221; and &#8220;<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-STYLE: italic">If we lose key government customers, or if our key government customers, all of which provide our products and services under Medicaid reimbursed programs, require us to reduce our prices before we are able to reduce costs, as a result of budgetary constraints or other reasons, our operating results would likely be negatively impacted.&#8221;</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 and the regulations promulgated thereunder (&#8220;HIPAA&#8221;) relate to the privacy and security of patient health information. As required by HIPAA, the Company executes Business Associate Agreements with its business partners and vendors, has appointed a Privacy Officer, and established policies, procedures and training standards. The Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health (&#8220;HITECH&#8221;) Act amended HIPAA to address privacy and security concerns associated with the electronic transmission of health information, which amendments became effective in September 2010. The Company is in the process of evaluating and updating its policies, procedures and training standards to comply with these requirements.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s PERS and related equipment is subject to approvals under the rules of the Federal Communications Commission (&#8220;FCC&#8221;) pertaining to radio frequency devices (Part 15) connected to the telephone system (Part 68).&#160;&#160;The Company submits all new product models for approval as required under the rules of the FCC.</font></div>

</tr></table>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In each business segment, AMAC faces competition, both in price and service from national, regional and local service providers of PERS, TH/DMM, telephone answering service and security monitoring systems.&#160;&#160;Price, quality of services and, in some cases, convenience, are generally the primary competitive elements in each segment.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">HSMS</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s competition within the HSMS segment includes manufacturers, distributors and providers of personal emergency response equipment and services, disease management and biometric carve out companies and a small number of security companies.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s market research estimates that approximately 20-30 companies are providers of competitive PERS products, 15-20 companies are providers of TH/DMM and 5-10 companies are providers of medication management systems. We believe PERS competitors serve, in the aggregate, approximately 1,000,000 individuals under the PERS product line. Because TH/DMM is a new field of healthcare services, reliable data of actual number of users is unavailable. Some of the Company&#8217;s competitors may have more extensive manufacturing and marketing capabilities as well as greater financial, technological and personnel resources.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s competition focuses its marketing and sales efforts in the following areas: hospitals, home care providers, physicians, ambulance companies, medical equipment suppliers, state social services agencies, health maintenance organizations, and direct marketing to consumers.</font></div>

The Company believes it competes favorably with respect to each of these factors. The Company believes it will continue to compete favorably by developing technological enhancements to the core systems that are expected to establish meaningful differentiation from its competitors.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">TBCS</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company believes that it is one of the larger medical-specific telephone answering service providers competing with more than 3,300 call centers across the United States, of which fewer than 10 percent are medical-only. The Company considers its scope of services more diverse than those of traditional sole proprietorships that make up the greatest portion of the competitive landscape. While many TBCS organizations compete for after-hours business, AMAC is offering new services catering to daytime work for large health systems and believes this application is scalable nationwide. As the Company migrates towards scalable contact management solutions, it expects to face new competition from competitors who, while perhaps&#160;&#160;not maintaining an exclusive medical call center focus such as AMAC does, are nonetheless competing for similar project work and contract activities.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">During each of 2009 and 2010, 11% of our revenue was derived from PERS services contracts with government customers for Medicaid reimbursed programs.&#160;&#160;Some of these agencies have been experiencing budget cuts and implementing cost cutting measures, which may cause them to demand price reductions or, alternatively, result in nonrenewal of existing contracts upon expiration if price reductions are not implemented.&#160;&#160;In addition, if government payors, such as Medicaid, deny or change coverage, reduce their current levels of reimbursement for healthcare services, or otherwise implement measures to regulate pricing or contain costs or if our costs increase more rapidly than reimbursement level or permissible pricing increases or we do not satisfy the standards or requirements for reimbursement, our revenues, operating margin or profitability may suffer and our business, performance, value, prospects, financial condition or results of operations may be adversely affected.&#160;&#160;If we lose key government customers, or if our key government customers require us to reduce our prices before we are able to reduce costs, as a result of the foregoing or other reasons, our operating results would likely be harmed.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">While there seem to be indications of the beginning of a recovery process, current economic conditions, including the credit crisis affecting global financial markets and the possibility of a global recession, could adversely impact the Company&#8217;s future business and financial results. These conditions could result in reduced demand for some of the Company&#8217;s products, increased order cancellations and returns, increased pressure on the prices of the Company&#8217;s products, increased number of days to collect outstanding receivables and/or increased bad debts on outstanding receivables, and greater difficulty in obtaining necessary financing on favorable terms. Over the last two years&#160;&#160;as a result of the housing and credit crisis, the Company realized a decline in its sale of PERS products to&#160;senior living facilities. Additionally, as a result of these economic conditions, the Company has experienced the impact of the reduction and termination of funding being provided to our customers in a State program.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In March 2010, Congress approved, and the President signed into law, the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act and the Health Care and Education Reconciliation Act (collectively the &#8220;Healthcare Reform Acts&#8221;).&#160;&#160;Among other things, the Healthcare Reform Acts seek to expand health insurance coverage to approximately 32 million uninsured Americans.&#160;&#160;Many of the significant changes in the health care industry resulting from the enactment of the Healthcare Reform Acts do not take effect until 2014, including a requirement that most Americans carry health insurance.&#160;&#160;We expect expansion of access to health insurance to increase the demand for our products and services, but other provisions of the Healthcare Reform Acts could affect us adversely. The Healthcare Reform Acts contain many provisions designed to generate the revenues necessary to fund the coverage expansions and to reduce costs of Medicare and Medicaid. We could be adversely affected by, among other things, changes in the delivery or pricing of or reimbursement for medical devices.&#160;&#160;Various health care reform proposals have also emerged at the state level, and we are unable to predict which, if any, of those proposals will be enacted.&#160;&#160;However, the ultimate effect of health care reform legislation or any future legislation or regulation could have a material adverse affect on our business, performance, value, prospects, financial condition, or results of operation.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-STYLE: italic">The earthquake and tsunami in</font> <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-STYLE: italic">Japan&#160;&#160;may affect our supply</font><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">.</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">As a result of the recent earthquake and tsunami as well as their aftermath in Japan, the lead time for certain components of our devices may increase.&#160;&#160;Although the Company currently has significant supply on hand, the Company may experience shortages if delays in receiving orders continue and become more severe.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-STYLE: italic; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Product liability and availability of insurance.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Because our business involves responding to personal emergencies, failures of our products or errors in the delivery of our services carry a risk of liability claims.&#160;&#160;We manage this risk through contractual limits on liability and damages, and by carrying insurance.&#160;&#160;However, the contractual limits may not be enforceable in all jurisdictions or under all circumstances.&#160;&#160;While historically we have not incurred significant liabilities due to such claims, a successful claim may be made for damages which exceed the coverage under any insurance policy.&#160;&#160;In the future, our insurance may become more expensive, and there can be no assurance that additional insurance will be available on acceptable terms.&#160;&#160;If one or more of these occur, it could have an adverse effect on our results of operations and financial condition.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Risks associated with our securities</font></div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-STYLE: italic; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">We have not established a recurring dividend program.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In December 2009 and again in July 2010, the Company declared a cash dividend of $0.10 per common share, which was paid to shareholders in January 2010 and September 2010, respectively.&#160;&#160;During the 2008 fiscal year, the Company did not pay dividends on its common shares. The Company&#8217;s current intention is to utilize cash resources for operations and acquisitions and it is therefore unlikely that the Company will pay dividends in the near and medium term.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-STYLE: italic; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Shares that are eligible for sale in the future may affect the market price of our common stock.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">As of March 25, 2011, an aggregate of 2,482,886<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>of the outstanding shares of our common stock are &#8220;restricted securities,&#8221; as that term is defined in Rule 144 under the federal securities laws.&#160;&#160;These restricted securities may be sold only pursuant to an effective registration statement under the securities laws or in compliance with the exemption provisions of Rule 144 or other securities laws provisions.&#160;&#160;Rule 144 permits the sale of restricted securities by any person (whether or not an affiliate of the Company) after six months, at which time the sales by affiliates can be made subject to Rule 144&#8217;s volume and other limitations and the sales by non-affiliates can be made without regard to Rule 144&#8217;s volume and other limitations, other than the limitation regarding public information set forth in Rule 144(c) for an additional six months.&#160;&#160;In general, an &#8220;affiliate&#8221; is a person that directly or indirectly, through one or more intermediaries, controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with the Company.&#160;&#160;The SEC has stated that generally, executive officers and directors of an entity are deemed affiliates of the entity. In addition, as of March 25, 2011,<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>738,343 shares are issuable pursuant to currently exercisable options or warrants which, upon exercise, would further add to the number of outstanding shares of common stock.&#160;&#160;Future sales of substantial amounts of shares in the public market, or the perception that such sales could occur, could negatively affect the price of our common stock.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Holders</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">As of March 25, 2011, there were 261 record holders of the Company's Common Stock.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Dividends</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">On July 19, 2010, the Company declared a special cash dividend in the amount of $0.10 per <font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt">common</font> share, or $956,034 in the aggregate, which was payable to the shareholders of record as of September 13, 2010.&#160;&#160;The dividend was paid on September 29, 2010.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">On December 16, 2009, the Company declared a special cash dividend in the amount of $0.10 per common share, or $950,364, which was accrued as of December 31, 2009.&#160;&#160;The dividend was payable to the shareholders of record as of December 28, 2009.&#160;&#160;The dividend was paid on January 15, 2010.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company received waivers from the lender under its existing credit facility prior to declaring the special dividends.&#160;&#160;As pursuant to the Company&#8217;s credit facility arrangement, the Company is prohibited from declaring and paying any dividends until such time that the loans under the credit facility have been satisfied in full.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s current intention is to utilize cash resources for operations and acquisitions and it is therefore unlikely that the Company will pay dividends in the near and medium term.</font></div>

<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160;</font></div>

<div><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Item 7.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Overview:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s primary business is the provision of healthcare communication services through (a) an expansive portfolio of home-based Remote Patient Monitoring&#160;technologies and (b) best in class monitoring and contact center services for healthcare providers and the pharmaceutical industry.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s business strategy leverages its ability to design, develop and integrate health and safety monitoring technologies with its multi-site, U.S. based healthcare communication services infrastructure to provide its customers with lower cost, high touch solutions.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s products and services are primarily marketed to the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries.&#160;&#160;The Company also offers certain products and services directly to consumers.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s activities are reported through two operating segments. The first segment, Health and Safety&#160;Monitoring Services, is comprised of the development and marketing of Remote Patient Monitoring (&#8220;RPM&#8221;) technologies.&#160;&#160;The second segment, Telephony Based Communication Services, is comprised of the provision of centralized call center solutions primarily to the healthcare community.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">28</font></div>

<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">The Health and Safety Monitoring Systems (HSMS) Segment</font>:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The primary goal of the HSMS segment is to provide life enhancing RPM technologies that allow seniors to remain independent at home. HSMS includes personal emergency response systems, medication adherence appliances and telehealth systems.&#160;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div>
<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt; TEXT-ALIGN: left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Personal Emergency Response Systems (PERS)</font></div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The division&#8217;s core business is the sales and marketing of our Personal Emergency Response System. The system consists of a console unit and a wireless activator generally worn as a pendant or on the wrist by the client.&#160;&#160;In the event of an emergency, the client is able to summon immediate assistance via the two-way voice system that connects their home telephone with the Company&#8217;s Emergency Response Center. The Company sells these PERS devices for use in either private homes or independent and assisted living facilities.&#160;&#160;AMAC&#8217;s PERS is sold through its primary brand VoiceCare&#174; and direct to consumer under Walgreen Ready Response&#8482;, Response Call&#8482;, and ApriaAlert&#8482;.&#160;&#160;In 2010 the Company derived approximately 50% of its revenue from PERS activities. Plans are underway to launch a mobile PERS solution late in 2011 to complement and expand its PERS offering.&#160;&#160;Moving forward, the Company will continue to grow this segment through internally driven sales and marketing efforts.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedSmart&#174;</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The second component of AMAC&#8217;s Remote Patient Monitoring (&#8220;RPM&#8221;) platform addresses another serious healthcare need-medication adherence. During the fourth quarter of 2009, the Company commercially released AMAC&#8217;s new monitored medication management tool, MedSmart<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#174;</font>. MedSmart is a system that organizes, reminds and dispenses pills in accordance with prescribed treatment regimens. With MedSmart&#8216;s event reporting and notification option, family caregivers and healthcare professionals can monitor a client&#8217;s adherence to their medication regimen. Through AMAC&#8217;s personalized notification system, alerts can be sent to track adherence, address dosing errors and predict refill requirements.&#160;&#160;Throughout 2010, the Company secured pilot program related contracts with several healthcare entities.&#160;&#160;In October 2010, the Company launched its first MedSmart direct to consumer pilot program.&#160;&#160;Moving forward in 2011, management is reevaluating more cost effective, direct to consumer deployment methods for MedSmart.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedTime<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#174;</font></font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">MedTime is an electronic medication reminder and dispensing unit marketed under an exclusive<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold">&#160;</font>licensing, manufacturing and distribution agreement which began in 1999.&#160;&#160;This agreement originates from PharmaCell AB, a Swedish company, with licensing rights extending throughout the United States, Canada and Mexico. The initial term of the agreement was five years requiring the Company to achieve certain purchase minimums in order to maintain exclusivity.&#160;&#160;Thereafter, the agreement converted to an evergreen with annual purchase minimums of 1,500 units. The Company has met all minimums with PharmaCell to date and continues to maintain exclusivity.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div id="PGBRK" style="MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt">
<div id="FTR">
<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>

<div id="PN" style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; WIDTH: 100%">
<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">29</font></div>

<div style="WIDTH: 100%; TEXT-ALIGN: center">
<hr style="COLOR: black" noshade size="2">
</div>
</div>

<div id="HDR">
<div id="GLHDR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="right"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>
</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Telehealth systems</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Rounding out AMAC&#8217;s RPM portfolio is AMAC&#8217;s robust telehealth delivery capability. As a distributor of the Health Buddy&#174; System, many of the Company&#8217;s customers have successfully demonstrated the value proposition of incorporating disease management technologies into a patient&#8217;s plan of care.&#160;&#160;We intend to continue to broaden our RPM portfolio with lower cost, high touch telehealth solutions.&#160;&#160;In 2010 AMAC launched an Independent Review Board study of its&#160;&#160;new low-cost telehealth solution, currently named &#8220;Telesmart&#8221; &#8482;.&#160;&#160;A commercial launch of this solution is planned for 2011.&#160;&#160;This AMAC operated telehealth platform is directed toward providers who require a low-cost solution, easy installation, reliable transmission of vital sign data in real-time and ease of use on the patient side.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Telephony Based Communication Services (TBCS) Segment:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">AMAC&#8217;s TBCS segment offers value added, customizable call center solutions that enhance the patient/provider communication experience. As part of our business development strategy, management continues to employ the most advanced telephony technology and information systems to develop services to respond to shifting market factors that affect healthcare client needs.&#160;&#160;In addition to technology, a critical component for successful expansion is the Company&#8217;s professionally trained call agent staff.&#160;&#160;The Company allocates resources to enhance contact agent training and staff development, new communication technology, and continuous quality control to support TBCS&#8217;s expansion efforts.&#160;&#160;The overall infrastructure has allowed AMAC to expand its footprint of services beyond traditional telephone answering services to provide more innovative, clinically oriented call center offerings.&#160;&#160;The Company&#8217;s TBCS segment is comprised of three service offerings:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">After Hours Answering Services</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">AMAC&#8217;s after hours services are classified as essential call center services with a fully-customizable approach to communications support.&#160;&#160;Basic services in this offering include traditional after hour answer and customized message delivery options, contact lists and on-call schedule management, all of which can be updated at the client&#8217;s convenience using the OnCall web portal.&#160;&#160;Through this portal, clients can also access the account&#8217;s call history, specifications and messages.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Concierge Services/Daytime Solutions</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">AMAC&#8217;s Concierge Services focus on the delivery of enhanced communications and help to streamline workflow within provider organizations. These solutions primarily serve hospitals and health organizations in the Northeast seeking to address staffing constraints in a variety of areas while extending first-class patient experience.&#160;&#160;Services range from providing skilled contact agents to support insurance eligibility verification programs; enhancing patient self care activities through post discharge follow-up programs, and providing specialized emergency department programs with strict reach guidelines to facilitate better treatment and care. Through more efficient and effective call processing, these solutions improve patient satisfaction, reduce cost, and increase revenue by maximizing the ratio of patients to available resources.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div id="GLFTR" style="WIDTH: 100%" align="left"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 8pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">&#160; </font></div>

</div>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify">&#160;</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Pharmaceutical Support and Clinical Trial Recruitment Services</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">AMAC&#8217;s clinical trial solutions and pharmaceutical support services are integral components of the overall growth strategy to drive revenue enhancement and expand our visibility.&#160;&#160;Under our PhoneScreen brand, AMAC is a leader in the field of patient recruitment, retention and contact center services.&#160;&#160;Using centralized telephone screening of potential clinical trial study subjects, PhoneScreen provides valuable data to inform advertising and patient recruitment strategies.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In 2010, AMAC commenced a new relationship with a third premiere pharmaceutical company. New project work in the fourth quarter of 2010 from this relationship contributed meaningfully to our fourth quarter results.&#160;&#160;We anticipate that our pharmaceutical support programs will be increasingly utilized to deliver enhanced patient-centric healthcare communication experiences on behalf of certain brands.&#160;&#160;Based upon new demand, we are recruiting nurses, health educators and other healthcare professionals that will allow us to provide additional turn-key solutions for our clients.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company has completed eleven acquisitions to date to facilitate growth within the TBCS division.&#160;&#160;Moving forward, the Company will continue to grow this segment through internally driven sales and marketing efforts and a more aggressive acquisition strategy.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Operating Segments</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">As mentioned above, for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2010, HSMS accounted for 51% of the Company&#8217;s revenue and TBCS accounted for 49% of the Company&#8217;s revenue.&#160;&#160;The Company believes that the overall mix of cash flow generating businesses from HSMS and TBCS, combined with its emphasis on developing products and services to support demand from customers and the emerging, home-based monitoring market, provides the correct blend of stability and growth opportunity.&#160;&#160;As the continued trend towards effective and precise end-to-end communication expands into new areas of health and wellness, AMAC believes that it can further its growth objectives more readily by realigning its segments. Management believes that realigning its segments into a more homogeneous device, technology, and services company will poise the organization for greater cross offering opportunities.<font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 12pt">&#160;</font> Based on the Company&#8217;s growth strategy and the complementary nature of its operating segments, management believes the Company&#8217;s outlook is very positive.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Components of Statements of Income by Operating Segment</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Loss on Abandonment:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Other income for the year ended December 31, 2009 and 2008 was approximately $200,000 and $272,000, respectively.&#160;&#160;Other income for the year ended December 31, 2009 and 2008 included a training incentive received from the State of New Mexico for hiring and training employees within the State and an economic development incentive through the City of Clovis aggregating approximately $88,000 and $298,000, respectively.&#160;&#160;These incentives were a result of the Company opening a network operating call center in New Mexico and hiring employees to serve as operators.&#160;&#160;The incentives in 2008 were partially offset by an adjustment to the Relocation and Employment Assistance Program credit due from New York City in the amount of $73,000.&#160;&#160;In addition, other income for the year ended December 31, 2009 included an insurance reimbursement of approximately $45,000 as a result of fire damage incurred at one of its call center locations.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s income before provision for income taxes for the year ended December 31, 2009 was approximately $4,815,000 as compared to $2,446,000 for the same period in 2008.&#160;&#160;The increase of $2,369,000 for the year ended December 31, 2009 primarily resulted from an increase in the Company&#8217;s revenue and a decrease in costs related to services and product sales, selling, general and administrative costs and interest expense.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-WEIGHT: bold; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">Liquidity and Capital Resources:</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The Company had a credit facility arrangement for $4,500,000 which included a revolving credit line which permitted borrowings of $1,500,000 (based on eligible receivables as defined) and a $3,000,000 term loan payable.&#160;&#160;The term loan was payable in equal monthly principal installments of $50,000, over five years, commencing January 2006.&#160;&#160;This term loan was paid in full during the second quarter of 2010 without any prepayment charge.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">During 2006, the credit facility was amended whereby the Company obtained a $2,500,000 and a $1,600,000 term loan, the proceeds of which were utilized to finance the acquisitions of MD OnCall and American Mediconnect, Inc.&#160;&#160;These term loans are payable over five years in equal monthly principal installments of $41,666.67 and $26,666.67, respectively. Additionally, certain of the covenants were amended.&#160;&#160;The $2,500,000 term loan was paid in full during the second quarter of 2010 without any prepayment charge.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">In December 2006, the credit facility was amended to reduce the interest rates charged by the bank such that borrowings under the term loan will bear interest at either (a) LIBOR plus 2.00% or (b) the prime rate or the federal funds effective rate plus 0.5%, whichever is greater, and the revolving credit line bears interest at either (a) LIBOR plus 1.75% or (b) the prime rate or the federal funds effective rate plus 0.5%, whichever is greater.&#160;&#160;The LIBOR interest rate charge shall be adjusted in 0.25% intervals based on the Company&#8217;s ratio of Consolidated Funded Debt to Consolidated EBITDA.&#160;&#160;In the third quarter of 2007, the interest rate was reduced by 0.25% based on this ratio.&#160;&#160;The Company has the option to choose between the two interest rate options under the amended term loan and revolving credit line.&#160;&#160;Borrowings under the credit facility are collateralized by substantially all of the assets of the Company.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">On April 30, 2007, the Company amended its credit facility whereby the amount of credit available under the revolving credit line was increased to $2,500,000.&#160;&#160;In June 2010, the term of the revolving credit line was extended through June 2013.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt"><br>
</div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">On May 12, 2010, the Company&#8217;s credit facility was amended whereby the Company obtained an additional $2,000,000 in the form of a term loan, the proceeds of which were utilized to partially finance its investment in Lifecomm relating to the development of&#160;the mobile PERS system.&#160;&#160;This term loan is payable over five years in equal monthly principal installments of $33,333.33, commencing June 1, 2010.&#160;&#160;The interest rate is&#160;the same as the previous term loans secured by the Company.</font></div>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><br>

<div style="DISPLAY: block; MARGIN-LEFT: 0pt; TEXT-INDENT: 0pt; MARGIN-RIGHT: 0pt" align="justify"><font style="DISPLAY: inline; FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: Times New Roman">The outstanding balance on the term loans and revolving credit line at December 31, 2010 was $2,060,000 and $750,000, respectively.&#160;&#160;As of December 31, 2010 and 2009, the Company was in compliance with the financial covenants in its loan agreement.</font></div>
